change_proposal.Recommendation: Remove only the rebuildable target/debug directory after a final process/path preflight; preserve target/release and all live, cache, research, ledger, backup, and journal data.
change_proposal.Why now: The data volume reached 99% used with only 18 GiB free during an active v51 lifecycle. A full volume can stop atomic checkpoint, ledger, cursor, or journal writes.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Repeated df observations, bounded directory-size audit, active process command lines, current release TUI paths, and the open HYPE lifecycle state.
change_proposal.Observed problem/opportunity: Approximately 29 GiB is held by rebuildable Rust debug artifacts while irreplaceable market and live evidence must be retained.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Regime independent; this is storage-capacity and telemetry-continuity remediation.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Do nothing, remove research/cache evidence, stop observers, or remove target/debug. Doing nothing risks write failure; deleting evidence damages research provenance; stopping observers loses prospective evidence; target/debug is the narrowest rebuildable candidate.
change_proposal.Proposed live change: No trading-system change. Delete the exact directory /Users/gestas/Prototypes/hypervector/target/debug only, after proving no running process maps or executes from it.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Recover approximately 29 GiB and increase write headroom without changing live execution, strategy behavior, or the running release TUI.
change_proposal.Main risks/failure modes: A forgotten debug process could depend on the directory; pending debug-only build artifacts would be lost; the next debug build would take longer; a path-selection mistake could delete unrelated data.
change_proposal.Validation completed: The directory is build output, target/release is separate, active TUI processes execute target/release, and no cargo, rustc, or target/debug process was observed during the bounded audit.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Immediately before deletion, resolve the exact real path, reject symlinks, prove the target is exactly the repository target/debug directory, check for open mappings/processes, and record pre-delete size and free capacity.
change_proposal.Success metrics: At least 25 GiB of free space recovered, all active v51 processes unchanged and healthy, HYPE remains protected, ledgers continue advancing, and the detached release TUI still launches.
change_proposal.Failure/rollback triggers: Any path mismatch, symlink, active debug process, inability to prove the exact target, backend fault, ledger stall, or release-TUI failure aborts cleanup. Removed build output is recoverable only by rebuilding.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence that target/debug is rebuildable and currently separate from live release binaries; medium confidence in recovered capacity until the exact pre-delete du and post-delete df measurements are recorded.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: Yes. Approval is requested to delete only /Users/gestas/Prototypes/hypervector/target/debug after the stated preflight.

falsifiers: A running process is found to execute or map target/debug.
